description: This file defines the QBusinessClient class, a specialized client for interacting with the 'QBusiness' service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It contains method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, updating, and retrieving resources related to the QBusiness service.

classes.name: Aws\QBusiness\QBusinessClient
classes.description: A client class used for making API calls to the QBusiness service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: associatePermission
methods.description: Associates a permission with a resource; returns a Result object.

methods.name: associatePermissionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a permission, returning a Promise.

methods.name: batchDeleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes multiple documents in a batch; returns a Result object.

methods.name: batchDeleteDocumentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version for batch deleting documents.

methods.name: chatSync
methods.description: Performs chat synchronization; returns a Result object.

methods.name: listApplications
methods.description: Lists all applications; returns a list of application data.
